title: Parameter-Free Zeroth-Order Optimization with Ellipsoidal Sampling
summary: Zeroth-order optimization methods are essential for solving black-box problems where gradient information is unavailable or expensive to compute. This paper presents POEM-ES, a novel parameter-free stochastic zeroth-order algorithm that extends the recent POEM method by integrating subspace preconditioning with ellipsoidal randomized sampling.
